column1: # Used by `npm run gate:calibrate -- --file=reference/go2joy-gate-calibration-set.csv` (PLN-261012 SG-51).
# Columns
#   question  a realistic Hotel Admin question (Vietnamese and English
#   audience  who is asking:  guest (signed-out visitor) | partner | receptionist | manager
#   expect    what the gate should do:  allow | refuse   (refuse = sign-in prompt
#   language  question language (informational)
#   topic     the Go2Joy knowledge category the question belongs to (informational)
#   status    DRAFT until a Go2Joy ops reviewer has confirmed the row
# For Go2Joy ops to review
#   1. Is the topic really PUBLIC (answerable to a visitor who never signed in) / PARTNER-only / MANAGER-only?
#      The three groups below follow the proposal in PLN-261012: sign-in and registration help is public;
#      day-to-day Hotel Admin operations (rates
#      payout / bank account / settlement and staff permissions are manager-only.
#   2. Do the wording and the Vietnamese read the way a hotel partner really types it?
#   3. Add the questions your support team gets most that are missing (aim for 10+ per group).
# Calibration needs real Voyage embeddings and a populated Qdrant (staging); with the stub embedder the
# CLI prints "NOT MEANINGFUL" and exits 3. Keep the manager-only rows' categories set to "Managers only"
# in the console (Knowledge > Categories) before running
column2: or those rows will report a leak.
